name: Forte Energy Limited
summary: Forte Energy Limited operates as an oil and gas exploration company in Australia. It holds a 100% interest in the WA-424-P hydrocarbon exploration permit located in the Browse Basin offshore Northwestern Australia. The company was formerly known as IPB Petroleum Limited and changed its name to Forte Energy Limited in February 2026. Forte Energy Limited was incorporated in 2009 and is based in West Perth, Australia.
